sn22.88:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn22.88:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā assaji kassapakārāme viharati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
sn22.88:1.3: atha kho āyasmā assaji upaṭṭhāke āmantesi
sn22.88:1.4: etha tumhe āvuso yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamatha upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatha
sn22.88:1.5: assaji bhante bhikkhu ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno
sn22.88:1.8: sādhu kira bhante bhagavā yena assaji bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
sn22.88:1.9: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato assajissa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn22.88:1.10: assaji bhante bhikkhu ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno so bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati evañca vadeti
sn22.88:1.11: sādhu kira bhante bhagavā yena assaji bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
sn22.88:2.1: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā assaji tenupasaṅkami.
sn22.88:2.2: addasā kho āyasmā assaji bhagavantaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ
sn22.88:2.4: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ assajiṃ etadavoca
sn22.88:2.5: alaṃ assaji mā tvaṃ mañcake samañcopi
sn22.88:2.7: nisīdi bhagavā paññatte āsane. nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ assajiṃ etadavoca
sn22.88:2.8: kacci te assaji khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ …pe… paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamoti.
sn22.88:3.1: na me bhante khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ …pe… abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamoti.
sn22.88:3.2: kacci te assaji na kiñci kukkuccaṃ na koci vippaṭisāroti.
sn22.88:3.3: taggha me bhante anappakaṃ kukkuccaṃ anappako vippaṭisāroti.
sn22.88:3.4: kacci pana taṃ assaji attā sīlato na upavadatīti.
sn22.88:3.5: na kho maṃ bhante attā sīlato upavadatīti.
sn22.88:3.6: no ce kira taṃ assaji attā sīlato upavadati atha kiñca te kukkuccaṃ ko ca vippaṭisāroti.
sn22.88:3.7: pubbe khvāhaṃ bhante gelaññe passambhetvā kāyasaṅkhāre viharāmi sohaṃ samādhiṃ na paṭilabhāmi
sn22.88:3.8: tassa mayhaṃ bhante taṃ samādhiṃ appaṭilabhato evaṃ hoti
sn22.88:3.10: ye te assaji samaṇabrāhmaṇā samādhisārakā samādhisāmaññā tesantaṃ samādhiṃ appaṭilabhataṃ evaṃ hoti
sn22.88:4.8: so sukhañce vedanaṃ vedayati sā aniccāti pajānāti anajjhositāti pajānāti anabhinanditāti pajānāti
sn22.88:4.9: dukkhañce vedanaṃ vedayati sā aniccāti pajānāti anajjhositāti pajānāti anabhinanditāti pajānāti
sn22.88:4.10: adukkhamasukhañce vedanaṃ vedayati sā aniccāti …pe… anabhinanditāti pajānāti.
sn22.88:4.11: so sukhañce vedanaṃ vedayati visaññutto naṃ vedayati
sn22.88:4.12: dukkhañce vedanaṃ vedayati visaññutto naṃ vedayati
sn22.88:4.13: adukkhamasukhañce vedanaṃ vedayati visaññutto naṃ vedayati sā aniccāti pajānāti …pe… anabhinanditāti pajānāti.
sn22.88:4.14: so kāyapariyantikañce vedanaṃ vedayamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmīti pajānāti jīvitapariyantikañce vedanaṃ vedayamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmīti pajānāti
sn22.88:4.15: kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītibhavissantīti pajānāti.
sn22.88:5.1: seyyathāpi assaji telañca paṭicca vaṭṭiñca paṭicca telappadīpo jhāyeyya
sn22.88:5.2: tasseva telassa ca vaṭṭiyā ca pariyādānā anāhāro nibbāyeyya.
sn22.88:5.3: evameva kho assaji bhikkhu kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmīti pajānāti jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmīti pajānāti
sn22.88:5.4: kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītibhavissantīti pajānātīti.
